# 3D AND VR AUDIT, ALL 187 CARDED GAMES

**Generated by `scripts/vr_audit_md.mjs` from `docs/3d-vr-audit.json`. Do not hand edit.**
Edit the JSON and rerun; the two cannot disagree because this table is not written by hand.

The vocabulary is section 4 of `HANDOFF-3D-VR.md` and nothing else is allowed in the
lane, route, effort and comfort columns. `scripts/vr_audit_check.mjs` asserts that, and
asserts one row per catalog row, and asserts that every row carries a `file:line` cite
or the word UNREAD with a reason.

⛔ **Nothing here has been run on a headset, and nothing here has been built.** This is a
static read of the source plus the shots in `docs/shots-vr/`. Every call in it should be
checked against the Quest 2 before it is believed, the same law `QUEST-COMPAT.md` carries.
